summary: based on trans-iso Mooney-Rivlin [91]. Not stable alone; use within a solid mixture. To enforce elasticity continuity at λm set `c3` = 0 (code recomputes c3 = c5/c4 · e^(−c4(λm−1))).
manual_ref: FEBio 4.x User Manual §4.2.1.6 Fiber Exp-Linear, p250（4.13）

lambda.note: 手册列出该参数，但 pyfebio 当前版本没有对应字段，建模时无法传入。
